title: Exploring pradimicin-IRD antineoplastic mechanisms and related DNA repair pathways.
authors: de Almeida, Larissa Costa; Calil, Felipe Antunes; Moreno, Natalia Cestari; Rezende-Teixeira, Paula; de Moraes, Luiz Alberto Beraldo; Jimenez, Paula Christine; Menck, Carlos Frederico Martins; Machado-Neto, Joao Agostinho; Costa-Lotufo, Leticia Veras
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和转录组研究pradimicin-IRD的DNA靶向抗肿瘤机制及DNA修复通路，虽涉及DNA-蛋白互作建模，但核心是药物-DNA作用而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法以对接和转录组为主，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: DNA-targeting agents have a significant clinical use, although toxicity remains an issue that plays against their widespread application. Understanding the mechanism of action and DNA damage response elicited by such compounds might contribute to the improvement of their use in anticancer chemotherapy. In a previous study, our research group characterized a new DNA-targeting agent - pradimicin-IRD. Since DNA-targeting agents and DNA repair are close-related subjects, the present study used in silico-modelling and a transcriptomic approach seeking to characterize the DNA repair pathways activated in HCT 116 cells following pradimicin-IRD treatment. Molecular docking analysis showed pradimicin-IRD as a DNA intercalating agent and a potential inhibitor of DNA-binding proteins. Furthermore, the transcriptomic study highlighted DNA repair functions related to genes modulated by pradimicin-IRD, such as nucleotide excision repair, telomeres maintenance and double-strand break repair. When validating these functions, PCNA protein levels decreased after exposure to pradimicin. Furthermore, molecular docking analysis suggested DNA-pradimicin-PCNA interaction. In addition, hTERT and POLH showed reduced mRNA levels after 6 h of treatment with pradimicin-IRD. Moreover, POLH-deficient cells displayed higher resistance to pradimicin-IRD than POLH-proficient cells and the compound prevented formation of the POLH/DNA complex (molecular docking). Since the modulation of DNA repair genes by pradimicin-IRD is TP53-independent, unlike doxorubicin, dissimilarities between the mechanism of action and the DNA damage response of pradimicin-IRD and doxorubicin open new insights for further studies of pradimicin-IRD as a new antineoplastic compound.
abstract_zh: DNA靶向药物具有重要的临床应用价值，尽管其毒性问题仍是制约其广泛应用的障碍。理解此类化合物诱导的作用机制及DNA损伤反应，可能有助于改善其在抗癌化疗中的应用。在先前的研究中，我们的研究团队表征了一种新型DNA靶向药物——普拉迪霉素-IRD。鉴于DNA靶向药物与DNA修复密切相关，本研究采用计算机模拟（in silico-modelling）和转录组学方法，旨在表征HCT 116细胞经普拉迪霉素-IRD处理后激活的DNA修复通路。分子对接分析显示，普拉迪霉素-IRD是一种DNA嵌入剂，并可能是DNA结合蛋白的潜在抑制剂。此外，转录组学研究突出了与普拉迪霉素-IRD调控基因相关的DNA修复功能，如核苷酸切除修复、端粒维持和双链断裂修复。在验证这些功能时，PCNA蛋白水平在普拉迪霉素暴露后下降。进一步地，分子对接分析提示存在DNA-普拉迪霉素-PCNA相互作用。此外，经普拉迪霉素-IRD处理6小时后，hTERT和POLH的mRNA水平降低。而且，POLH缺陷细胞对普拉迪霉素-IRD的耐药性高于POLH正常细胞，且该化合物阻止了POLH/DNA复合物的形成（分子对接）。由于普拉迪霉素-IRD对DNA修复基因的调控不依赖TP53，与多柔比星不同，普拉迪霉素-IRD与多柔比星在作用机制和DNA损伤反应上的差异，为普拉迪霉素-IRD作为新型抗肿瘤化合物的进一步研究提供了新见解。
